text: Candy is a home-appliance brand of Haier Europe, which is part of Haier Smart Home through its 2019 acquisition of the Candy-Hoover Group.
short: Candy is a Haier Europe / Haier Smart Home brand.

source.name: Haier Europe: Who We Are
source.quote: Haier Europe is part of Haier Smart Home that reinforced its presence in the European market with the acquisition of the Candy-Hoover Group in 2019.
source.note: Company page without a date and 403s scripts; archived copy of 2025-12-06 used. The same page lists Candy among Haier Smart Home's global brands.
